description: Defines data structures and classes for representing and manipulating abstract syntax trees (trees) used in Torch's JIT frontend, including Tree, String, Compound, and pretty printing utilities.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: Base class for all tree nodes representing syntax elements, supporting type identification, child access, and mapping functions.

classes.name: String
classes.description: Subclass of Tree representing string atoms in the syntax tree.

classes.name: Compound
classes.description: Subclass of Tree representing compound expressions with multiple subtrees.

classes.name: pretty_tree
classes.description: Utility class for pretty-printing Tree objects.

methods.name: matchD
methods.description: Internal method for detailed subtree matching with filename and line info.

methods.name: matchNumSubtrees
methods.description: Checks if the number of subtrees matches expected count.

methods.name: matchNumSubtreesD
methods.description: Internal method for subtree count validation with detailed info.
